description: This file defines a class 'Smarty_CacheResource_Pdo_Gzip' which extends 'Smarty_CacheResource_Pdo' to implement caching with GZIP compression for PDO-based cache resources in Smarty templates.

classes.name: Smarty_CacheResource_Pdo_Gzip
classes.description: A cache resource class that adds GZIP compression/decompression to PDO-based Smarty cache resources.

methods.name: inputContent
methods.description: Encodes the content with GZIP deflate before saving to database.

methods.name: outputContent
methods.description: Decodes the content with GZIP inflate when retrieving from database.
